title: None of you should hold his penis with his right hand while urinating, nor wipe himself after answering the call of nature using his right hand, nor breathe into the vessel
hadeeth: Abu Qatādah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "None of you should hold his penis with his right hand while urinating, nor wipe himself after answering the call of nature using his right hand, nor breathe into the vessel."
explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) clarified here some manners as he forbade men from holding their penis with their right hand while urinating and forbade the act of removing impurity from the private parts, front or back, with the right hand because the right hand is meant to be used for noble matters. He also forbade breathing into the vessel from which one is drinking.
hints: Demonstrating how Islam is in the lead when it comes to manners and cleanliness.
Avoiding filth, but if one has to touch it, then let him do so with his left hand.
Highlighting the nobility of the right hand and its superiority over the left one.
Perfection of the Islamic Shariah and comprehensiveness of its teachings.
hadeeth_intro: Abu Qatādah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said:
hadeeth_ar: عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ رضي الله عنه قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَا يُمْسِكَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ ذَكَرَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ وَهُوَ يَبُولُ، وَلَا يَتَمَسَّحْ مِنَ الْخَلَاءِ بِيَمِينِهِ، وَلَا يَتَنَفَّسْ فِي الْإِنَاءِ».
hadeeth_intro_ar: عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ رضي الله عنه قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ:
explanation_ar:
بَيَّنَ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بعض الآداب؛ حيث نهى أنْ يُمْسِكَ الرجل ذكره حال البول بيده اليمنى، وأن تُزال النجاسة من القُبُلِ أو الدُّبُرِ باليد اليمنى؛ لأن اليمين أعدت للمكارم، 
كما نهى أن يتنفس الإنسان في الإناء الذي يشرب فيه.
hints_ar: بيان سَبْق الإسلام في الآداب والنظافة.
اجتناب الأشياء القذرة، فإذا اضطر إلى مباشرتها، فليكن باليسار.
بيان شرف اليمين وفضلها على اليسار.
